name: UI Design System Builder
description: Build a complete design system: starting from a design brief and user research, produce a design token set (colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow), component library conventions, responsive breakpoint strategy, and state-handling rules, emitted as CSS variables or Tailwind configuration. Includes a design-type decision matrix giving layout pattern and information density per product type. Use this skill whenever the request mentions a design system, design tokens, style conventions, a component library, or unifying visual style.
